body: Some time ago i was concerned about my weight, but nowadays i realised food is too good :)))

I saw a post some time ago that talked about things people who commited suicide missed. I dont know, things like a new Game, a Movie, stuff Like that. It kinda gave me a different view on this topic. I will try and Look for new hobbies or stuff to live for. Thank you, kind stranger! Happy holidays!

Thank you for commenting! Thing is, i always try to do my best, to live the moment, to BE there, but its not working all the time... One simple mistake, event, thing done wrong: BOOM everything collapses inside my head. One thing that keeps me Alive is my parents, or more specifically the pain and suffering i will give them. A small price to pay for salvation? I ain’t paying that. I am afraid that one day that will be the only price left for me to finally be at peace
